hero.title: The Most Widely Deployed Open Source Cloud Software in the World
hero.text: Deployed by thousands. Proven production at scale. OpenStack is a set of software components that provide common services for cloud infrastructure.
hero.text2: OpenStack is developed by the community. For the community. [Learn how to contribute ⮕](/community/)

diagram.title: Cloud Infrastructure for Virtual Machines, Bare Metal, and Containers
diagram.text:
Openstack controls large pools of compute, storage, and networking resources, all managed through APIs or a dashboard.

Beyond standard infrastructure-as-a-service functionality, additional components provide orchestration, fault management and service management amongst other services to ensure high availability of user applications.

features.title: At the Edge
features.text: Telecoms and retailers rely on OpenStack for their distributed systems

userStory.name: Blizzard Entertainment
userStory.short_description: Blizzard Entertainment has been using OpenStack as a private cloud to host its game services since 2012.
userStory.description: Video game developer, Blizzard Entertainment, implements OpenStack autoscaling to support running video games, like best-selling game Overwatch, in the cloud.

userStory.name: Walmart
userStory.short_description: The largest company in the world relies on OpenStack to manage e-commerce
userStory.description: Walmart is the largest company in the world with 11,000 stores and over 80 million monthly website visitors. To manage e-commerce, including peak shopping times like Black Friday, Walmart relies on its OpenStack cloud with over 170,000 cores in more than 30 regions.

userStory.name: China Mobile
userStory.short_description: The largest mobile telecom’s network is powered by OpenStack including workloads like 5G.
userStory.description: China Mobile’s telecom network has more than 800 million subscribers and 3 million base stations. China Mobile is now building up the biggest NFV network based on OpenStack with more than 50,000 servers in the network.

userStories.title: The World Runs on OpenStack
userStories.subtitle: OpenStack is trusted to manage 40 Million+ cores around the world, across dozens of industries.
